topic: How to Read a Commercial Rent Roll
caption:
Reading a commercial rent roll is one of the fastest ways to understand a building’s income and lease obligations. For landlords, owners, and investors in Chester County and Montgomery County, a clear rent roll shows tenant names, unit IDs, lease start and end dates, current rent, and how expenses are allocated. Watch for CAM, tax, and insurance recoveries, and whether figures are shown gross or net. Remember a rent roll does not replace leases, tenant credit checks, or property inspections — use it alongside financial statements. Want a practical checklist and a local sample review? Visit dmsellscre.com/investors to access resources and request a rent-roll review tailored to your property.
